title: Model contract
written: Contract written next to the model
auditBroken: BROKEN: the log was tampered with or a write was lost

levelDesc.declarativo: There is a model and little else. Good for trying an idea, not for deciding anything about anyone.
levelDesc.trazable: It was measured on data the model had not seen, and the labels' origin is known.
levelDesc.reproducible: On top of that, the split is declared and the population has subjects: the experiment can be repeated and there is no leakage between partitions.
levelDesc.verificable: On top of that, the corpus was read more than once: it is known how much of the label is criterion and how much is the person applying it.

protocol.title: Study protocol
protocol.intro: Declared once; the model contract transcribes it. Whatever is left blank is not invented: it shows up as a limitation of the contract.
protocol.inclusionHint: Who was included: population, period, referral route…
protocol.exclusionHint: Who was left out, and why.
protocol.populationHint: Where the samples came from: one site, several, which population.
protocol.intendedUseHint: What the model is meant to be used for. A model trained for screening and used for diagnosis is not badly trained: it is badly used.
